cases.project_context: HL-GA Battery Company LLC (Hyundai Motor Group + LG Energy Solution EV battery cell joint venture), Ellabell, Bryan County, Georgia, USA; adjacent to Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America.

response.value: Hyundai/LG did not cancel or scale back the project; Hyundai separately announced continuation of a $2.7B expansion of the wider Georgia complex despite the raid. The facility was reported physically complete Dec 2025 and opened April 2026 with 500+ employees.

cases.project_context: Micron Clay Megafab (Fab 1 of a planned multi-fab campus), Clay, New York (Onondaga County), USA.

response.value: Site-clearing and grading work for the wider campus continues in 2025 on schedule even though concrete/foundation work for Fab 1 specifically is deferred to Q2 2026 -- a phased, partial-continuation response rather than a full project halt.

cases.project_context: Samsung Austin Semiconductor fab (operating facility), Austin, Texas, USA.
cases.partial_reason: affected_task_retrieval and response_evaluation are partially_usable only: this is an operating-facility production disruption, not a construction-project WBS milestone, and the response detail found is general rather than granular.

response.value: Phased equipment inspection, reconfiguration, and restart, per Samsung's own public statement ('efforts to resume operations... inspect and reconfigure the facility'). No more granular technical mitigation plan was found.

cases.project_context: Rivian Georgia EV Plant (Stanton Springs North), Social Circle / Rutledge, Georgia, USA.
cases.partial_reason: affected_task_retrieval and delay_MAE are NOT_USABLE: the 'restart' is defined differently across at least 5 overlapping, imprecisely-dated milestones, and the DOE loan amount itself is reported inconsistently over time. Usable only for risk_classification (partial), evidence_retrieval, and response_evaluation (partial).

response.value: Rivian secured, then later restructured, DOE financing ($6.6B conditional commitment Jan 2025, later 'up to $4.5B'); separately announced an 'optimized capacity plan' raising planned annual capacity from 200,000 to 300,000 vehicles.

cases.project_context: Renesas Naka Factory, N3 building (300mm automotive-chip production line), Hitachinaka, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan.

response.value: Renesas published a sequential, numbered public disclosure series (UPDATE 1 through at least UPDATE 10) tracking capacity restoration in stages; pursued an expedited equipment-replacement/requalification effort as the substantive recovery action.

TSMC hired 900+ local workers by Q1 2023, sent experienced Taiwanese technicians to train local staff, and later reached a project labor agreement with the Arizona Building and Construction Trades Council.

cases.project_context: General Motors North American assembly plants (Fort Wayne IN, Silao Mexico, Wentzville MO) -- April 2021 shutdown wave.
cases.partial_reason: response_evaluation is partially_usable only: the response is a general strategy statement, not a granular mitigation plan. Note also this event was part of a chronic, recurring 2021 disruption pattern (repeat waves in July and September), not a single isolated event -- see source_conflicts.

response.value: GM prioritized available semiconductor supply toward its most profitable/high-demand vehicles; no finer-grained mitigation detail was found.

cases.project_context: Ford Kansas City Assembly Plant (Claycomo, Missouri), USA -- F-150 / Transit production.
cases.partial_reason: response_evaluation is partially_usable only: response detail found is general, not plant-specific. IMPORTANT: this case corrects a STEP 1 error (L3-017) that had wrongly merged this US event with a German event (see V3-004 / source_conflicts).

response.value: Ford prioritized completing partially-assembled vehicles awaiting missing chip-dependent parts rather than halting all output; no more specific chip-allocation strategy for this plant was found.

cases.project_context: VinFast Manufacturing US LLC plant, Chatham County 'Moncure megasite', North Carolina, USA.

response.value: VinFast repeatedly requested schedule extensions (first 2024-05-10, citing a global EV sales slowdown affecting its financing) and ultimately proposed a drastically scaled-back project (from 7,500 to approximately 1,400 jobs) rather than completing the original plan.

cases.project_context: CATL Debrecen Battery Plant (cell-production lines), Debrecen, Hungary.

response.value: CATL secured 'all permits required for trial operations' before starting; was separately required to complete rectifications of occupational-safety deficiencies (the nickel-dust exposure incident) as a precondition.

cases.project_context: Intel Ohio One (New Albany, Ohio) semiconductor fabs, USA.

response.value: Construction continues (not halted) at a deliberately slower pace; Intel's own statement: 'taking a prudent approach to ensure we complete the project in a financially responsible manner' (EVP Naga Chandrasekaran).
